description: Source code for CategoricalColorScale class implementing a color scale with features like analogous colors, forced colors, and collision avoidance, used in data visualization within the superset-ui-core package.

classes.name: CategoricalColorScale
classes.description: A class extending ExtensibleFunction to provide a color scale with advanced features such as analogous colors, forced colors, and collision avoidance, used for categorical data visualization.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the CategoricalColorScale with colors, forced colors, and optional color scheme.

methods.name: incrementColorRange
methods.description: Extends the color range with analogous colors based on the current domain size.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the color for a given value, considering forced colors, existing labels, and feature flags.

methods.name: isColorUsed
methods.description: Checks if a color is used in the current slice.

methods.name: getColorUsageCount
methods.description: Counts how many times a color is used in the current slice.

methods.name: getNextAvailableColor
methods.description: Finds the least used color not currently assigned to adjacent labels to reduce collision.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Overrides the color for a specific value.

methods.name: getColorMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of data values to their assigned colors.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates an independent copy of the scale.

methods.name: domain
methods.description: Gets or sets the domain of the scale.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Gets or sets the range of colors for the scale.

methods.name: unknown
methods.description: Gets or sets the value used for unknown inputs.
